## Checklist

- [ ] Title follows Conventional Commits (`feat: …`, `fix: …`)
- [ ] Scenarios written before the code
- [ ] `npm test`, `npm run test:coverage` and `npm run test:e2e` pass
- [ ] Mutation: core 100 %, boundary ≥ 80 % on the changed files
- [ ] README / skill updated when the canvas actions or behaviour change
